dct_description_sm:
The RUISSO program of the RSMA (Network for Monitoring the Aquatic Environment) aims to document the water quality of streams and inland water bodies in the Montreal metropolitan area, according to bacteriological and physicochemical analyses.
-
The RUISSO program of the RSMA (Aquatic Environment Monitoring Network) aims to document the water quality of streams and inland water bodies in the Montreal agglomeration, based on bacteriological and physicochemical analyses.

Le programme RUISSO du RSMA (Réseau de suivi du milieu aquatique) vise à documenter la qualité de l’eau des ruisseaux et des plans d’eau intérieurs de l’agglomération montréalaise, selon des analyses bactériologiques et physicochimiques.
-
The RUISSO program of the RSMA (Réseau de suivi du milieu aquatique) aims to document the water quality of streams and inland water bodies in the Montreal agglomeration, based on bacteriological and physicochemical analyses.
